baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exceptive construction إلا ابتغاء and the genitive chain وجه ربه الأعلى make the focus phrase a sole-purpose vector with a specified heading and endpoint.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pursuit supplies motion, face supplies orientation, lordship supplies the governing endpoint, and highest rank removes competing lower termini. The phrase therefore organizes desire spatially and hierarchically, not merely as an inward sentiment.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and pursuit make ابتغاء an active, sustained motion toward an object rather than a passive preference.
Orientation and direction give the pursuit its heading and make وجه function as a destination-bearing term.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the personal governing endpoint named by ربه.
Nobility and high rank make الأعلى a hierarchy-setting qualifier that subordinates rival ends.

changed_reading.before: The phrase says only that the agent acts for God.
changed_reading.after: The phrase excludes every rival purpose except a live pursuit whose entire heading is fixed on the authority and incomparable rank of his Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pursued object is وجه itself, joined directly to ربه, rather than a named gift, wage, or possession from the Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: The face can be the presented front, direct facing, and the self represented by the face. Those coexisting branches turn the object of pursuit from a transferable benefit into encounter with the Lord's own presence, while الأعلى preserves the asymmetry of that encounter.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit keeps the relation desiderative and unfinished: the seeker is moving toward, not already possessing, the object.
Face and front supply a presented presence rather than an abstract benefit.
Facing and confronting make the pursued relation direct and face-to-face.
The self-or-essence branch allows وجه to point beyond a visible surface to the Lord himself.
Rising and height keep the encounter vertically asymmetrical rather than reciprocal between equals.

changed_reading.before: The seeker wants a reward, approval, or other good supplied by his Lord.
changed_reading.after: The sought good is non-transferable: direct orientation toward and encounter with the Lord himself displaces reward as the phrase's center.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ربه stands between the pursuit and الأعلى, and its packet mapping preserves both lordly completion and a non-dominant nurture-and-growth inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant lord branch repairs and completes stage by stage; the split mapped root adds rearing and growth; الأعلى adds rising. Together they permit a developmental reading in which the sought Lord is also the one who raises and completes the seeker.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit supplies the seeker's active participation in a developmental movement.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship an ongoing formative process rather than a title alone.
The non-dominant nurture-and-growing branch reinforces stagewise formation while remaining explicitly split-root evidence.
Rising and being high convert الأعلى from a static epithet into the upward limit of the formative motion.

changed_reading.before: The seeker moves toward a Lord who is already Most High.
changed_reading.after: Seeking the Most High can also mean entering the care by which the Lord repairs, grows, and raises the seeker toward completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وجه can carry social eminence, while رب and الأعلى carry authority and highest rank inside an exclusive-purpose construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can relocate the economy of standing: instead of seeking a favorable face among human notables, the seeker directs the need for recognition toward the Lord whose rank exceeds every social hierarchy.

activation_trace.role: Status and eminence activate وجه as the socially recognized face or standing one might otherwise court.
Lordship and authority relocate the source of recognized standing away from human patrons.
High rank makes the Lord's standing categorically superior to the social ranks displaced by the exception.
Seeking makes status not a possession but the contested object whose direction is being reassigned.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes private sincerity without a public or social dimension.
changed_reading.after: The verse may also dismantle patronage and prestige-seeking by relocating the quest for a favorable face to the only unsurpassable authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covering of 92:1 and disclosure of 92:2 place the focus face between hiddenness and visibility. The pursued orientation can remain constant even while the deed's outward face alternates between concealed and manifest.

activation_trace.role: Sustained pursuit supplies the continuity that can survive changing conditions of visibility.
Face and outward front provide the visible surface whose appearance can be covered or disclosed.
A covering that rises over and hides something supplies the concealed phase of the mechanism.
Uncovering and appearance supply the revealed phase without requiring a change in underlying direction.

structural_cues: The packet orders cosmic covering immediately before cosmic disclosure, establishing a reversible visibility sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover, disclosure, pursuit, and face; I infer that motive persists beneath changes in public visibility. A live alternative is that the cosmic pair marks contrast only and says nothing about social legibility.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive purpose is a static inward claim.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive purpose is a visibility-invariant orientation: whether the deed is hidden or exposed, its face remains turned toward the same Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies diverse striving, while the split mapping of س ع ي keeps both purposeful motion and aimless going live. ابتغاء plus وجه becomes the discriminator between mere movement and movement with an integral destination.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and pursuing specify intentional movement toward a desired object.
Orientation and destination distinguish a vector from undirected motion.
Purposeful movement toward an object supplies the strong, directed pole of striving.
The non-dominant image of neglected, aimless going supplies a live counter-pole inside the split mapping.
Dispersion and scattering distribute the contextual strivings across divergent trajectories.

structural_cues: 92:4 predicates divergence of the audience's striving before later presenting the exclusive pursuit of 92:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed striving, a split-root image of aimless going, and dispersion; I infer a vector-field contrast in which destination distinguishes kinds of motion. The non-dominant mapping may instead be lexical noise, leaving only diverse purposeful works.

changed_reading.before: ابتغاء is simply another instance of the striving already mentioned.
changed_reading.after: ابتغاء وجه ربه is the focusing operation that turns scattered motion into a coherent trajectory and exposes movement without a true destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving and enacted truth lead into the opening of ease, while the opposed sequence leads into difficulty and crooked resistance. The proper-course branch of وجه lets purpose and action form a feedback loop: the chosen orientation is embodied in deeds, and the course then becomes more or less traversable.

activation_trace.role: The proper aspect or course makes وجه the sound management and traversable way of an affair.
Giving supplies the concrete outward act by which an orientation becomes a course.
Fulfilling truth in action makes the claimed orientation behaviorally real.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply increased traversability along the enacted course.
Crookedness, opposition, and obstruction supply the counter-course produced around the rejected orientation.

structural_cues: The two mirrored sequences culminate in يُسرى and عسرى, making ease and difficulty directional outcomes rather than isolated conditions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed, enacted truth, a proper course, opening, and obstruction; I supply the recursive arrow by which practice shapes traversability. A live alternative is that facilitation is solely an external response and does not feed back through formed disposition.

changed_reading.before: Seeking the Lord's face is an intention that precedes and explains the deed.
changed_reading.after: Seeking the Lord's face is also a course enacted by giving and truthfulness, a course that becomes progressively open while its contrary twists into obstruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pursuit is not self-authored navigation. Contextual guidance supplies gentle direction to the path; the focus supplies active seeking and a face as heading; lordship supplies the party who undertakes that guidance.

activation_trace.role: Seeking supplies the responsive motion of the seeker along a path.
Direction and destination give the guided motion a determinate heading.
Lordship and authority identify the guide whose claim governs the route.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the route that precedes the seeker's response.

structural_cues: The emphatic إن علينا للهدى assigns guidance to the divine side before the focus names the human pursuit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an assigned guidance relation and an active pursuit; I infer a two-agent coupling in which the Lord provides direction and the seeker answers it. Alternatively, 92:12 may declare guidance's availability without specifying how pursuit and guidance interact.

changed_reading.before: The seeker independently discovers and chooses a route toward the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The seeker actively pursues a heading already gently indicated and undertaken by the Lord; agency remains real but responsive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context brackets later and first, while the split mapping of الأولى activates priority and entitlement. الأعلى then converts temporal comprehensiveness into an order of claims: the Lord who encompasses first and last also has the highest prior claim on purpose.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority make temporal possession relevant as a claim upon the seeker's purpose.
Highest rank translates the temporal bracket into a hierarchy of claims.
Laterness after the first supplies one boundary of the complete temporal span.
Beginning and precedence supply the other boundary of the temporal span.
The non-dominant priority-and-entitlement branch changes firstness from chronology into precedence of claim.

structural_cues: The paired الآخرة والأولى precedes the singular الأعلى, creating a sequence from temporal endpoints to vertical superlative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies first, later, high rank, authority, and a split-root priority image; I infer a conversion from time-order to claim-order. The safer alternative keeps 92:13 as temporal ownership and الأعلى as an unrelated epithet.

changed_reading.before: The deed is aimed at a delayed, later reward rather than an immediate one.
changed_reading.after: The exception is not delayed compensation but priority: across the entire first-to-last span, the highest Lord has the first and overriding claim on the act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away, being moved aside, and protection establish a spatial field of facing and distance. In that field, seeking the Lord's face is a positive turn that determines both what the seeker approaches and what the seeker is kept away from.

activation_trace.role: Orientation and direction make the focus phrase the positive heading within the spatial contrast.
Direct facing supplies the approach relation opposed to turning away.
Turning the back and withdrawing provide the explicit counter-orientation.
Distancing and putting aside supply the protective relocation away from danger.
Repelling harm by protection gives the distancing a functional rather than merely geometric purpose.

structural_cues: 92:16 and 92:17 place opposed movements in sequence: one agent turns away, while the other is passively moved away from the fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning, facing, distancing, and protection; I infer a shared orientation architecture in which approach to one endpoint entails distance from another. Alternatively, the movements may be separate outcomes rather than one spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Seeking the Lord's face names only an internal motive.
changed_reading.after: It names a bodily and existential reorientation: turn toward this face, and the whole field of approach, avoidance, and protection is rearranged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context joins giving, accumulated wealth, and purification-growth. The focus joins lordly nurture to rising. This permits a conversion model: what leaves the possessor as wealth becomes formative increase in the seeker under the Most High.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion provide the formative process into which relinquished wealth is converted.
The split-root nurture-and-growth image reinforces development while remaining a secondary activation.
Rising and height make the resulting formation an ascent rather than mere replacement.
Giving supplies the outward transfer that begins the conversion.
The taking and accumulation of wealth supply the stored quantity that is deliberately released.
Growth and increase supply the positive result that counters material depletion.
Purity and soundness keep the increase qualitative rather than equating it with more possessions.

structural_cues: The active sequence يؤتي ماله يتزكى immediately precedes the no-repayment clause and the exclusive purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transfer, stored wealth, growth-purity, nurture, and rising; I infer a conversion arrow from outward loss to inward formation. A live alternative treats يتزكى as motive or accompanying state, not an effect of giving.

changed_reading.before: Giving for the Lord is a material loss accepted for a separate spiritual reason.
changed_reading.after: The gift changes the medium of increase: accumulated wealth leaves the hand and becomes purified growth within a lordly process of completion and ascent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exhaustive negation removes every nearby human creditor, while favor and recompense supply the ledger that is denied. The following إلا leaves one surviving orientation. Seeking the Lord's face is therefore not one motive among social exchanges but the severance of compensatory patronage.

activation_trace.role: Seeking supplies the sole positive purpose remaining after reciprocal motives are removed.
Status and eminence expose the human faces and patrons whose recognition could otherwise function as repayment.
Highest rank relocates recognition beyond the hierarchy of human benefactors and beneficiaries.
Exhaustive scope under negation removes every possible human claimant from the ledger.
Nearness and presence locate the denied claim in the seeker's immediate social relation.
Favor and good condition provide the benefit that could have created reciprocal obligation.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the general exchange mechanism that the negation cancels.
Collecting and satisfying a debt sharpens recompense into a ledger of outstanding claims.

structural_cues: 92:19's total negation and passive تُجزى are followed directly by 92:20's إلا, so the focus phrase is what remains after debt-purpose is removed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favor, proximity, recompense, status, and exception; I infer a social ledger whose causal claim on the gift is severed. The narrower alternative denies repayment for a specific prior favor without excluding every public effect of giving.

changed_reading.before: The gift is sincere because it is not performed for praise.
changed_reading.after: The gift exits the whole human credit system: it neither settles a beneficiary's debt nor purchases a patron's face, leaving only pursuit of the highest Lord as its live claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is grammatically open pursuit; the following verse supplies satisfaction and acceptance. The sequence lets رضا answer ابتغاء without turning the sought face into a commodity: desire reaches repose through alignment rather than acquisition.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and pursuit supply an open desiderative motion awaiting resolution.
Orientation makes resolution a matter of arriving in right alignment rather than possessing an object.
Satisfaction as the opposite of displeasure supplies repose and acceptance at the end of pursuit.

structural_cues: The future-marked ولسوف يرضى follows the exclusive pursuit without naming a material object of satisfaction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pursuit followed by future satisfaction; I infer that رضا is the experiential arrival of the prior orientation. A live alternative is that satisfaction concerns a separate reward not specified in the packet.

changed_reading.before: Seeking the Lord's face remains indefinitely ascetic and unsatisfied.
changed_reading.after: The pursuit has a non-possessive arrival: the seeker comes to رضا, a state in which desire rests because its orientation has become sufficient.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surplus or usury image enters through the non-dominant ر ب و target mapped from focus ر ب ب, not through the ordinary lordship branch. It remains anchored by that explicit packet mapping and by adjacent wealth, growth, and debt-repayment cues. Downstream prose should present it only as a split-root anti-ledger activation, never as a lexical gloss of رب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory attached to ربه includes surplus increase, while the focus's exclusive pursuit follows the giving of wealth and denial of human repayment.

activation_trace.role: Usurious surplus activates the possibility of increase extracted through an exchange, which the surrounding gift can reverse.
Seeking redirects the desired increase away from extraction from another person.
Accumulated wealth supplies the capital whose ordinary logic would be preservation or increase.
Growth and increase provide a non-extractive alternative form of gain.
Debt collection supplies the financial-social mechanism explicitly denied by the preceding clause.

changed_reading.before: The giver relinquishes wealth without expecting ordinary repayment.
changed_reading.after: The giver also refuses to make another person finance his increase: wealth is released from debt-producing surplus and redirected toward growth sought from the Lord alone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain hydraulic reading: downpour, cloud, watercourse, and growth are branch images rather than the direct senses demanded by the forms in 92:18-20. It remains anchored in ابتغاء, ربه, وجه as direction, and the contextual giving-growth chain. Render it as a material analogy for resource flow, not as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots preserve excessive rain, persistent cloud, and direction branches, while 92:18 preserves a watercourse branch for giving and an explicit growth branch.

activation_trace.role: The main downpour image supplies abundant release rather than measured reciprocal payment.
Orientation and direction keep the imagined flow attached to the focus phrase's destination.
A persistent low cloud that nurtures plants supplies the sustaining source of the ecological mechanism.
A watercourse and the opening of its channel recast giving as enabling flow.
Growth and increase supply the irrigated result of the released flow.

changed_reading.before: Giving is a transfer from one owner to another.
changed_reading.after: Giving can be imagined as opening a channel: possession ceases to dam the resource, and directed release irrigates growth under the Lord's sustaining care.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The scouting image is form-distant from ابتغاء and therefore cannot control the reading. It remains visibly anchored in the focus root and gains coherence from giving, front-facing, and contextual precedence. Downstream prose should mark it as an anticipatory image: the deed sent ahead, not a claim that ابتغاء literally means a scout here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A scouting-advance-party branch belongs to the focus pursuit root, and وجه can be the front toward which the preceding gift is sent.

activation_trace.role: Scouting advance parties supply an anticipatory movement sent before a larger arrival.
Face and front provide the forward edge or meeting point toward which the advance movement travels.
Giving supplies the deed that can be imaginatively dispatched ahead of the giver.
Beginning and precedence reinforce the temporal logic of something going first.

changed_reading.before: The gift is an action completed in the present.
changed_reading.after: The gift becomes an advance party of the self, sent ahead toward the Lord's face and testing the direction in which the giver's larger life will follow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because the 92:15 form is directly situated in fire-contact, while prayer is a different branch of the same mapped root. It remains anchored by the packet's co-present branches and by the focus's pursuit and facing. Render it only as a bifurcation of sustained contact—worshipful attachment versus consuming encounter—not as an alternative parsing of 92:15.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins active pursuit to direct facing; the nearby ص ل ي inventory holds both binding worship and meeting fire within one root-local field.

activation_trace.role: Seeking supplies the chosen approach that determines what kind of contact is pursued.
Facing and encounter make contact, rather than abstract belief, the shared mechanism.
Prayer as binding worship supplies one sustained mode of approach and attachment.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the destructive counter-mode of direct contact.

changed_reading.before: The focus purpose and the fire warning belong to separate moral statements.
changed_reading.after: The branch field suggests two rival contacts: active facing can become worshipful attachment to the Lord's face or culminate in involuntary encounter with consuming heat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reciprocity is not encoded by the simple form يرضى alone; it is activated by the root inventory's mutual-satisfaction branch. The reading remains anchored in the focus's direct-facing construction and the immediate sequel. Downstream prose should qualify it as relational resonance, not assert that 92:21 grammatically names both parties.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pursuit of a face-to-face relation in 92:20 is immediately followed by a satisfaction root whose inventory includes mutual رضى.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit supplies one party's movement into the relation.
Direct facing supplies the interpersonal geometry in which reciprocity can be imagined.
Mutual satisfaction and conciliation activate a two-sided closure rather than solitary contentment alone.

changed_reading.before: The seeker alone eventually becomes satisfied.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory resonance, the sought face-to-face relation may close in mutual consonance: pursuit is answered by a رضى that can be imagined as relational rather than solitary.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from generic sincerity to an exclusive vector: pursuit, direction, authority, and height jointly specify where the whole act is going.
The diverse-striving and guidance cues changed that vector into responsive navigation, distinguishing purposeful direction from scattered or merely moving activity.
The gift and no-recompense sequence turned the focus into a severance of the human favor ledger, including the pursuit of patrons, status, and repayment.
Giving wealth became a conversion from possession into purified growth under lordly nurture, while the sequel's رضا supplied a non-possessive arrival.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's split mappings materially changed the reading: ر ب ب also activated nurture, growth, and—under containment—surplus; س ع ي held directed and aimless motion together; الأولى opened priority as well as chronology. Cross-domain images of watercourse, cloud, scouting, and contact were retained as exploratory mechanisms because each remained attached to focus words and produced a distinct changed reading.
remaining_uncertainties: وجه can sustain direction, direct presence, social status, and outward visibility without requiring those readings to collapse into one.
The arrows from giving to purification, from practiced orientation to ease, and from pursuit to رضا are abductive; the packet supplies the terms and sequence but not every causal direction.
The non-dominant mapped roots and material analogies are live activations, not claims about the direct lexical sense of the focus forms.
The mutual-satisfaction outlier exceeds what the simple form يرضى alone guarantees and must remain explicitly qualified.
